text: Every claim in x_brind_claims_warranty_claim needs one guarantee: a partner can only ever read their own company's rows.
Dmitri builds a Script Include that resolves the logged-in user's partner company from sys_user.company.
A new read ACL on the claim table compares that partner company to the record's own partner_company field.
Only a match -- or an internal admin or reviewer role -- returns true. Tested both directions, it holds.
Next: the partner self-service portal, built to lean on this exact ACL.
